raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

SGLang currently uses its in-tree QuickReduce implementation on ROCm and considers QuickReduce only after custom all-reduce during collective selection. AITER also provides a native QuickReduce implementation with its own supported-shape checks, quantization settings, and kernel thresholds.

This PR adds an opt-in path that uses AITER's native QuickReduce communicator for tensor-parallel groups and considers eligible QuickReduce operations before custom all-reduce. AITER leaves QuickReduce disabled unless `AITER_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION` selects a codec. The intended setting for this path is `INT4`. This matches AITER's intended selection policy while leaving SGLang's default communicator and ordering unchanged.

## Modifications

- Add `SGLANG_USE_AITER_QUICK_REDUCE`, default off, through SGLang's typed environment-variable interface.
- When enabled on a HIP tensor-parallel group, initialize QuickReduce from `aiter.dist.device_communicators.quick_all_reduce`.
- Prefer an eligible AITER QuickReduce operation before custom all-reduce. Unsupported shapes continue through the existing communicator selection chain.
- Fall back to SGLang's in-tree QuickReduce implementation and default ordering if the AITER QuickReduce module is unavailable.
- Keep non-TP groups, non-HIP platforms, and the default-off path unchanged.
- Enable the path with `SGLANG_USE_AITER_QUICK_REDUCE=1` and `AITER_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4`. The first switch selects AITER QuickReduce. The second configures and enables its INT4 codec.
- Add CPU unit coverage for the HIP/TP opt-in gate, default-off behavior, QuickReduce-first ordering, and unsupported-shape fallback.

## Accuracy Tests

Pending GSM8K A/B results.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Pending Kimi-K3 AgentX A/B results on 8x MI355X.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

                         self.qr_comm = QuickAllReduce(

+                                    "support"
+                                )
+                            else:
+                                logger.info(

                 except Exception as e:
                     logger.warning(f"Failed to initialize QuickAllReduce: {e}")
         elif self.world_size > 1 and is_hip():
@@ -973,6 +1006,17 @@ def _resolve_outplace_all_reduce_method(

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("is_hip", "group_name", "enabled", "expected"),

+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("use_aiter_quick_reduce", "quick_reduce_eligible", "expected"),

+        (True, True, "qr"),

+        (False, True, "ca"),

+)
+def test_aiter_quick_reduce_selection_policy(
